390:t_013:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Roar, $$ガンレオン$$! We're going all out!!」

390:t_015:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「All right! That's my man, The Crusher!」

390:t_015:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「W-what is this? My body's getting hot...!」

390:t_015:5.en:
$$カヲル$$
「The power of a life that endures pain... He's wonderful.」

390:t_015:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「What is this...? Just watching that guy makes strength well up in me...」

390:t_015:7.en:
$$マリ$$
「It's not my imagination or just the mood...! This... is real power!」

390:t_015:8.en:
$$桂$$
「This feeling...! The direction is different, but it's the same as the power $$ガドライト#pilot$$ gave off!」

390:t_015:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So $$ランド$$ and $$ガンレオン$$ have also awakened to the power of the $$スフィア$$... to $$スフィア・アクト$$.」

390:t_015:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「How do you like that, $$ストラウス$$!!」

390:t_015:13.en:
$$ストラウス$$
「Aha... The armor got busted, huh.」

390:t_016:0.en:
$$ストラウス$$
「In that case... I don't need this thing anymore!」

390:t_017:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Here's my payback, Darling!」

390:t_018:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Ahahaha! Just what I'd expect from you, Darling! You can even take this attack!」

390:t_018:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Me? I'm $$ストラウス$$.」

390:t_018:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「My full name is $$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$. I'm the leader of $$ハイアデス$$, the strongest fighting group in the galaxy, and the Supreme Commander of the $$新地球皇国$$ forces.」

390:t_019:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$!」

390:t_019:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You made it, $$ダバラーン$$.」

390:t_019:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「O-oh... That form of yours...!」

390:t_019:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Darling is seriously amazing, you know. My armor got wrecked.」

390:t_019:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'll apologize to $$アウストラリス$$ myself, so don't worry about it, $$ダバラーン$$.」

390:t_019:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Yes, ma'am! For my part, it is an utmost honor to see Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$ like this after so long!」

390:t_019:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So stiff... Just call me $$エルーナ$$ like you used to.」

390:t_019:7.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Then I shall do as you say!」

390:t_020:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「So that's what $$ストラウス$$ really is...!?」

390:t_020:1.en:
$$桂$$
「No way! It's not a buffalo, it's a Holstein!?」

390:t_020:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Ahaha, did I surprise you? Maybe $$アウストラリス$$ was right, and armor really is necessary after all.」

390:t_020:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What is the meaning of this, $$ストラウス$$!」

390:t_020:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Call me $$エルーナルーナ$$. Daddy went to the trouble of giving me a nice name, and $$ストラウス$$ is so bland.」

390:t_020:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Who on earth is that!?」

390:t_020:7.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「So that's the Supreme Commander of the Empire's forces that wiped out the $$地球連邦軍$$...」

390:t_020:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I mean, as the head of an organization like an army, you do need a certain dignity and presence. I agreed to wear the armor myself.」

390:t_020:9.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「But the Earth has as good as fallen already. From here on, I'll do things my way.」

390:t_020:11.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Isn't it obvious? A battle that gets the blood pumping.」

390:t_020:13.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「$$ハイアデス$$ has been traveling across the galaxy in search of battle...」

390:t_020:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I heard we could have even more fun battles if we joined $$サイデリアル$$, and it looks like that's finally coming true.」

390:t_020:15.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Guys! Are You Ready!」

390:t_020:18.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「These guys...! Do they think war is a game!?」

390:t_020:19.en:
$$万丈$$
「It's pointless to get angry, $$カミーユ$$. Their mental makeup is completely different from ours.」

390:t_020:20.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The greedy golden bull... The source of that power seems to lie in desire.」

390:t_020:22.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Exactly! And I think Darling, who can take on my fights, is the best partner there is.」

390:t_020:24.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Darling is Darling, so why shouldn't I call Darling 'Darling'?」

390:t_020:25.en:
$$メール$$
「I'm the only one who gets to call Darling 'Darling'!」

390:t_020:26.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Meanie! Fine, then! I'll take him by force!」

390:t_020:27.en:
$$シモン$$
「She may look like she's fooling around, but the pressure is way bigger than in her armor form!」

390:t_020:28.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So with the armor blown off, her desire is at full blast too!」

390:t_020:29.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$エルーナ$$! Ignore a man like that and give the order to advance at once!」

390:t_020:30.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「What is it, $$ダバラーン$$? Jealous?」

390:t_020:31.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I-I am your loyal right hand, $$エルーナ$$! S-such an improper thing...!」

390:t_020:32.en:
$$赤木$$
(So that guy's devotion wasn't loyalty after all...!)

390:t_020:34.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I suppose I should at least apologize to $$アウストラリス$$. Let's wrap this up in 4 minutes!」

390:t_020:36.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Warriors of $$ハイアデス$$! $$エルーナ$$'s orders have been given! In these 4 minutes, we will wipe out $c!」

390:t_020:37.en:
$$ランド$$
「Try it if you can, $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

390:t_020:38.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Heh... Let's have plenty of fun, Darling!」

390:t_021:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Not bad! ...Though I did just take my armor off, so I couldn't really get into it.」

390:t_021:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Being a sore loser is pathetic!」

390:t_021:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「No, no! $$ハイアデス$$ doesn't know the first thing about regretting a loss!」

390:t_021:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'm just really happy that I get to fight such a fun opponent again.」

390:t_021:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Bye-bye, Darling! You too, $c! Next time, I'm going all out too!」

390:t_022:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Too baaad, looks like time's up.」

エルーナ.evidence: Nickname of エルーナルーナ (glossary): she says 'like the old days, エルーナ様 is fine' (390:t_019:6) and Dabalan then addresses her as エルーナ様; honorific dropped.
